meta.name: Punk Hazard
meta.description: La primera isla del Nuevo Mundo es un extraño lugar cubierto de llamas en una mitad, y temperaturas congelantes en la otra. En lo que parece ser un lugar inhabitable a primera vista, pronto revelará un laboratorio, un científico maniático, y cierto Shichibukai.

videos.title: Punk Hazard
videos.overview: Fresh off the adventure at Fishman Island, the Sunny is caught in a massive whirlpool and dragged off course. A desperate cry for help leads the Straw Hats to Punk Hazard, an island engulfed in flames and inhabited by a mythic beast.

videos.title: Adventure on the Burning Island
videos.overview: Luffy, Robin, Usopp, and Zoro face a powerful dragon, and Luffy gets up close and personal with a torso-less figure. Elsewhere, Nami, Sanji, Chopper, and Franky find themselves imprisoned with the pieces of a human face!

videos.title: About My Torso
videos.overview: Luffy’s group finds themselves up against a gang of centaurs, Brook battles an aggressive mysterious torso, and Vice Admiral Smoker encounters someone highly unexpected! Meanwhile, Nami and Chopper seek a safe exit for a group of children.

videos.title: The Lake of Bandits
videos.overview: Luffy’s group takes a deadly plunge into icy waters, and Trafalgar Law uses his unique abilities to rearrange Nami’s group and place the Straw Hats into a state of chaos! Then, things heat up when G-5 squares off with Law.

videos.title: CC
videos.overview: Luffy is excited to once again cross paths with Trafalgar Law. While Vice Admiral Smoker determines his next move, an exceptionally large pirate with alligator legs tells Luffy and the Straw Hats the true story of Punk Hazard’s mysterious transformation!

videos.title: Yeti Cool Brothers
videos.overview: The giant children fly into a mysterious rage, and Chopper discovers the true reason for their unusual condition! Meanwhile, Zoro, Brook, and Sanji cross paths with a dangerous duo, and the story of how Trafalgar Law arrived at Punk Hazard is revealed.

videos.title: Pirate Alliance
videos.overview: Luffy agrees to an unexpected alliance with Trafalgar Law, but the Straw Hats refuse to leave the island until the children are safe. Meanwhile, the gaseous master of the island unleashes something extremely deadly!

videos.title: Blizzard with a Chance of Slime
videos.overview: Zoro, Sanji, and Brook continue their search for the samurai, and Law tries to sneak Chopper into the laboratory! And then, Luffy’s battle with his old nemesis Smoker is interrupted by the arrival of a terrifying toxic blob.

videos.title: My Name Is Kin'emon!!
videos.overview: Law's plan to infiltrate Caesar’s facility hits a snag when an unexpected guest complicates things. Meanwhile, Chopper investigates the Master’s lab, and the mysterious samurai shows what he can do with a full body!

videos.title: Vergo and Joker! The Beginning of Caesar's Masterplan!
videos.overview: Caesar gathers his young test subjects, shocking secret identities are revealed, and the poisonous purple blob continues its march across the island! Meanwhile, Nami and Usopp get an unexpected helping hand in their fight to save the children.

videos.title: The Experiment Begins! Shinokuni Unleashed!
videos.overview: A candy addiction leads the children to return, and Caesar plans to show the world his new and improved Smiley! Luffy and the Straw Hats next find themselves pursued by a deadly cloud of gas that turns living things into statues of ash!

videos.title: The Counterattack Begins!
videos.overview: Law has a trick up his sleeve that turns the tide in the alliance’s favor, to include an on-the-spot partnership with former foes. Zoro and company reunite with Nami and Sanji, and it is all Luffy’s group can do to ensure everyone’s safety in the lab.

videos.title: G-5's Sacrifice and the Betrayal of the Vice Admiral!
videos.overview: Caesar hatches a plan to forever silence his enemies, and Tashigi’s men make the ultimate sacrifice! Luffy races toward Caesar to deliver on his promise to beat and capture him, and Chopper does all he can to keep the children from consuming more candy.

videos.title: The Mastermind in the Shadows and the Battle Between Gas and Rubber!
videos.overview: Law finds the room that could ruin the New World, and Luffy hopes to bring Caesar’s reign of terror to a brutal end! With Law's true ambitions revealed, Doflamingo flies into action to protect his criminal operation!

videos.title: Vice Admiral vs. Vice Admiral and the Truth Behind Punk Hazard's Destruction!
videos.overview: Smoker attacks the estranged Vice Admiral Vergo for assaulting his men, and in the trash heap, Luffy meets something strange. Meanwhile, Caesar’s bloated words to his men about the island’s history do not match what occurred.

videos.title: The Dragon Named Momonosuke and the Menacing Snow Fruit User!
videos.overview: Luffy befriends a dragon that used to be a human boy, and Vice Admiral Smoker continues his brutal battle with the villainous Vergo. Mocha tries to keep the Master’s candy away from her friends, and Zoro pits his steel against snow in a battle with Monet.

videos.title: Zoro's Strongest One-Sword Style and Mocha's Plight!
videos.overview: Zoro vs. Monet: a duel to the bitter end. But when Tashigi comes to lend a hand, she will need her full might to compensate for Zoro's weakness. Meanwhile, Mocha is running out of options for keeping the candy away from the children.

videos.title: Luffy and Law's All-out Attack! The Takeover of the New Era!
videos.overview: Brownbeard heroically attempts to expose Caesar as a villain, and the horrific truth about Punk Hazard is finally revealed! Luffy makes Caesar pay for his crimes against the children, and Smoker risks his life for a chance to see Vergo fall in battle!

videos.title: The Strongest Grizzly Magnum and the Assassins from Dressrosa!
videos.overview: Law concludes his epic battle with Vergo, and Luffy looks to land a devastating blow on the murderous gasbag mastermind. Meanwhile, word of Luffy and Law’s alliance spreads throughout the world, and Joker sends a team to rescue Caesar.

videos.title: Die for Me! The Dangerous Man Makes His Move!
videos.overview: As the Straw Hats and co. flee the crumbling laboratory, Caesar’s desperate act of vengeance thwarts Joker’s plan to forever silence his enemies. Franky continues his battle with Buffalo and Baby 5, and Usopp takes a shot at capturing Caesar.

videos.title: The Alliance's Target and the Departure!
videos.overview: Bitter enemies set aside their differences to enjoy a well-deserved feast. The weary Marines and the rescued children get teary-eyed as they say goodbye to the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Law enters into treacherous negotiations with Joker.

videos.title: The Arrival of the Mysterious Man and the News Coo!
videos.overview: Doflamingo—a.k.a. Joker—arrives on the scene and wreaks havoc! Only an icy intercession can save Smoker and send Joker off to rethink his strategy. Meanwhile, the Sunny sails through the rough seas of the New World where even a bit of hail portends doom!
